subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path (PO vs card) - Redwood for ZenHealth
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@zenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood next steps - procurement questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — it was helpful to understand Redwood's dedicated offering and the potential cost upside for inference at scale. Procurement had a few clarifying questions before we move to an internal RCA:

- Do you support purchase orders (PO) for Dedicated/Private deals, or is card payment required at sign? If PO, do we need an SOW and a signed contract first?
- Does Redwood appear on AWS Marketplace or similar so we can route via our marketplace purchasing workflow?
- Can you share an SOW or one-page summary and a line-item pricing breakout for the Reserved Capacity (monthly) vs Hosted usage?

Our timeline: we'd like to finalize procurement approach (PO vs card) this month and have the finance team confirm pay method. Who should procurement contact at Redwood for paperwork/PO routing?

Appreciate any artifacts you can share.

Best,
Sasha Patel
Procurement Manager | ZenHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood next steps - procurement questions

Thanks Sasha — great questions and glad the call was useful. Quick recap and answers below plus next steps.

Recap / Answers:
- Payment methods: immediate onboarding can use card for Hosted; for Dedicated or Private (reserved capacity) we support PO-based purchasing. For PO flow we typically execute an SOW + Master Services Agreement (MSA) and then issue invoices on the cadence in the SOW.
- SOW & paperwork: attaching an initial SOW template and a pricing breakout (see attachments). The SOW is boilerplate — we can update term length, capacity, and billing cadence based on ZenHealth's preference.
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace for our Hosted offering and we're in progress with an entry for Reserved Capacity (should be live within 2–3 weeks). If you want the marketplace path we can route to our Partnerships team to confirm listing and marketplace SKUs.

Who to contact:
- PO routing & contract questions: Michael Grant (Finance) — michael_grant@redwood.com
- Legal / MSA redlines: Rishi Malhotra (Sales Ops / Legal liaison) — rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf] [Attachment: Redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx]

Suggested next steps:
1) Let me know whether ZenHealth prefers PO (SOW+MSA path) or card (fast onboarding).
2) If PO, please share procurement contact info and any internal PO template. We will: (a) send an editable SOW with terms populated, (b) route to Michael for invoicing details, and (c) have Rishi review any legal/contract redlines.
3) Weekly short check-ins until PO is issued — I can book a 15m slot each Friday to move this along.

If helpful, I'll also include our AWS Marketplace contact and estimated SKUs this week.

Thanks — I'll stand by for the procurement contact and preferred payment path.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Office: 415-555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf]
[Attachment: Redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood next steps - procurement questions

Marissa / Michael — forwarding Sasha's procurement note. Quick internal notes:

- Pricing: the attached pricing sheet has both monthly reserved and hosted per-token comparators. For large Reserved Capacity deals (> $100k/mo) we typically offer a billing cadence that matches PO workflows (net-30 / net-45) per customer's preference.
- Discount: I'm comfortable offering a 10% entry discount for the first 3 months on Reserved if they commit to a 12-month term; we should confirm with Finance.
- Marketplace: I've pinged Partnerships to expedite the Reserved SKU listing — should have an ETA by EOD Friday.

Michael — can you confirm the invoicing contact details and whether we can accept ZenHealth's standard PO template (if they send it)? Also, confirm whether net-30 is acceptable on our side for this tier.

Rishi
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha.patel@zenhealth.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@zenhealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood next steps - procurement questions — weekly check-in

Hi Sasha — quick check-in as discussed. Wanted to see where procurement is on: PO vs card, and whether you had a chance to share the SOW/pricing with finance.

To make this as frictionless as possible, I can:
- Send an editable SOW pre-filled with the 12-month Reserved Capacity terms + the 10% introductory discount (if you confirm term).
- Route the invoice contact to Michael so your team can validate the PO template.
- Share the AWS Marketplace SKU details if you want to purchase via Marketplace instead (we can provide a Marketplace quote).

Where is it stuck on your side? If helpful, I can set a 15m call with procurement + Michael this week to close the loop.

Thanks, and happy to adapt to your procurement cadence.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Office: 415-555-0198
